description:
What is This Part?
This is the OEM Suzuki Samurai JA Model, Passenger’s Front Seat.
These are NOT COVERS but rather the COVERS/FRAMES & CUSHIONS for the Passenger Side.
These seats are not sold with a headrest nor recline mechanism.
All you will need to do is to remove your existing seats and take off the seat slides and seat recline mechanisms and bolt directly on to these.
These seats are Suzuki OEM seats so your parts will fit perfectly on these seats; no drilling, no cutting; just bolts right up.
The seat color pattern is a light color that is designed to reflect the suns heat giving you a cooler seat in the summer, especially when the tops off.
These seats are made from heavy, durable pressed vinyl and have an off-white patterned seating area and a black side and gray back.
These will fit in both JL and JX models.
NOTE: These seats are on Clearance due to color variation and light staining. The front sides vary slightly. The back side is BLACK and the bottom cushion is GRAY. They will need to be covered, or reupholstered.
These are high quality usable seats that will last many years with the only negative being minor cosmetic deficiencies that can easily be overlooked and corrected.
You will need your existing Suzuki OEM seat hardware to assemble these seats. We also sell slides if those are needed.
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
CLEARANCE (see note above)
Qty 1 – Seat Bottom Cushion – Passenger’s Side
Qty 1 – Seat Back Cushion – Passenger’s Side
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1984 All Models
